# 1on1 Devon - 2026-09-17

**Time:** 45 min, Thursday 9 AM
**Person:** [[Devon Park]]

## What Devon brought up

**Fractional-share drift.** Found Tuesday. 0.4% of investing positions are off by fractional shares against DriveWealth. All of them trace to corporate-action events: a stock split in an underlying ETF holding. Our position ledger applies the split ratio and rounds; DriveWealth carries more precision. Small amounts, but it's a reconciliation break in a product that's in beta with real money.

He's writing up the investigation tomorrow. The fix is conceptually simple (consume corporate-action events directly and stop deriving them) but touches the position model, so it needs a design review.

Risk: investing GA can't go if positions don't reconcile to the broker.

**The reconciliation job is real now.** The thing he was sketching in his evenings back in May ([[1on1 Devon - 2026-05-22]]) is now what's catching these. He built the nightly reconciliation against DriveWealth, plus a ledger check against Pillar on the ACH side. He's quietly proud of it. He should be loudly proud of it.

**Staff.** He asked directly: what would a staff case look like for him? Good. He's been circling it since May.

## What I brought up

**Sidekiq ACH deletion.** The 30-day stability hold on the new pipeline ends today. Zero missed cutoffs since Aug 18. Deletion of the old Sidekiq ACH code is approved. He'll write the decommission plan tomorrow. I want it done before the old code becomes something someone "temporarily" re-enables.

Decision: old Sidekiq ACH code is approved for deletion as of today.

**Staff case, honestly.** He has the technical depth. What's missing for staff is evidence of influence outside his own code: a design others build on, a standard others adopt, people he's grown. Reconciliation is a strong start because it's a system, not a component. Sarah's onboarding counts. Next: write the reconciliation design up as a standard every money-moving system has to meet.

## Commitments

- [x] Devon: fractional-shares investigation write-up by Sep 18
- [x] Devon: Sidekiq ACH decommission plan by Sep 18
- [ ] Devon: delete Sidekiq ACH code by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Me: write down what a staff case looks like for Devon, with Marcus, by 2026-10-23

## Read on Devon

Confident in a way he wasn't in May. Ownership did that. Watch: he'll want to fix the drift and delete the old code at the same time, and he can't do both well this month. Recon first.
